name: menthol + pramoxine
uses: Uses temporarily relieves itching and irritation of the external genital area associated with minor skin irritation
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only. Do not use in or around the eyes internally When using this product : use only as directed avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes do not apply to open wounds or broken skin Stop use and ask a doctor if: condition worsens symptoms persist for more than 7 days, or clear up and occur again within a few days If pregnant or breast-feeding , ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children . If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
